learning_outcomes.text: Describe the major subsystems of a satellite and their roles
Explain how satellite communication links work at a concept level
Describe link budgets, frequency bands and antennas conceptually
Explain ground segment and mission operations basics
Describe constellations and their coverage trade-offs
Communicate satellite system trade-offs to non-specialists

integrative_case: A systems class outlines, at concept level, a small communications satellite service: they describe the platform subsystems, the uplink/downlink design, a qualitative link budget, the ground segment, and whether a constellation is needed, presenting trade-offs for review.

case-based decisions in the integrative case
